nameOrigin: slang for a child; ‘kid’ is a baby goat

pokedexEntries.x: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

pokedexEntries.or: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

pokedexEntries.y: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
